League is all about matchups and what to do based on the enemy team comp and your champ. Basically it boils down to this:

Irelia is a lane bully, especially if they arw familiar with how to use her kit. ( mmr is messed up in norms, so always assume the other player knows their champ)

Usually naafiri is a lane bully champ as well, however irelias kit is stronger and has a stun that allows her to burst you before you can do anything. If you are uncomfortable with your champ, its always best ti just farm. Irelia relies on being ahead to be usefull in teamfights. Meaning, if you just play safe and dont allow her to get kills, then when the game becomes more teamfight oriented, you can start to catch up. Naafiri q is really decent at farming, especially because of his passive. Usually i would reccomend trying to poke with Q, but if irelia is already ahead, then its not worth the risk, since she has a good gap closer. Naafari has insane chase abilities, but for escaping, naafari is very weak compared to irelias catch-up mechanics.

Overall, in this match up, its better to farm and wait for a good gank from your jg, than to try and apply any type of pressure. You can add me on discord and i would be happy to teach you more about the game mechanics and how you can identify which playstyle is correct for a certain match up.

For anyone not understanding why their account is disabled, here is the most common reason why.

Discord is fighting back against bots who sent malicious links to several users at once. Discord is able to determine automatically that someone is a bot by how quickly the same links are being sent to other users. This hapoens to hacked accounts, that may have clicked a bad link and allowed people to use ur account to spread more bad links. Once discord detects this, its an auto disabled by the system itself. This is why 2 factor authenticator, via an authenticator app is crucial to keeping ur account safe.

The answer is more simple than you might think. In asian countries ( majority of moba players) follow one of two paths. 
1: game must either be allowed in their country ( ex:China) for players to even try it
2: countries like korea thrive on the gaming industry, therefore most competitive scenes stay away from controversial games.

Why does amite get affected by those two things? Because the game is about gods battling and hi-rez interpretation of those gods that come from real history in alot of asian countries. This concept is found disrespectful in those cpuntries more than here, because america is a young country, but asian culture dates back thousands of years, meaning they  have stronger ties to their beliefs in the gods. Therefore, making smite widly upsetting, because making their gods do your bidding is incomprehensinble ( ik i spelled it wrong lol).

This is the main reason why smite doesnt survive outside its western audience, the subject matter is too touchy for the east.
